name: viewshed
description: Compute the viewshed of a raster dataset.

input_arguments.name: input-format
input_arguments.description: Input formats

input_arguments.name: open-option
input_arguments.description: Open options

input_arguments.name: input
input_arguments.description: Input raster datasets

input_arguments.name: quiet
input_arguments.description: Quiet mode (no progress bar or warning message)

input_arguments.name: output-format
input_arguments.description: Output format ("GDALG" allowed)

input_arguments.name: creation-option
input_arguments.description: Creation option

input_arguments.name: overwrite
input_arguments.description: Whether overwriting existing output dataset is allowed

input_arguments.name: append
input_arguments.description: Append as a subdataset to existing output

input_arguments.name: position
input_arguments.description: Observer position

input_arguments.name: height
input_arguments.description: Observer height

input_arguments.name: sd-filename
input_arguments.description: Filename of standard-deviation raster

input_arguments.name: target-height
input_arguments.description: Height of the target above the DEM surface in the height unit of the DEM.

input_arguments.name: mode
input_arguments.description: Sets what information the output contains.

input_arguments.name: max-distance
input_arguments.description: Maximum distance from observer to compute visibility. It is also used to clamp the extent of the output raster.

input_arguments.name: min-distance
input_arguments.description: Mask all cells less than this distance from the observer. Must be less than 'max-distance'.

input_arguments.name: start-angle
input_arguments.description: Mask all cells outside of the arc ('start-angle', 'end-angle'). Clockwise degrees from north. Also used to clamp the extent of the output raster.

input_arguments.name: end-angle
input_arguments.description: Mask all cells outside of the arc ('start-angle', 'end-angle'). Clockwise degrees from north. Also used to clamp the extent of the output raster.

input_arguments.name: high-pitch
input_arguments.description: Mark all cells out-of-range where the observable height would be higher than the 'high-pitch' angle from the observer. Degrees from horizontal - positive is up. Must be greater than 'low-pitch'.

input_arguments.name: low-pitch
input_arguments.description: Bound observable height to be no lower than the 'low-pitch' angle from the observer. Degrees from horizontal - positive is up. Must be less than 'high-pitch'.

input_arguments.name: curvature-coefficient
input_arguments.description: Coefficient to consider the effect of the curvature and refraction.

input_arguments.name: band
input_arguments.description: Input band (1-based index)

input_arguments.name: visible-value
input_arguments.description: Pixel value to set for visible areas

input_arguments.name: invisible-value
input_arguments.description: Pixel value to set for invisible areas

input_arguments.name: maybe-visible-value
input_arguments.description: Pixel value to set for potentially visible areas

input_arguments.name: out-of-range-value
input_arguments.description: Pixel value to set for the cells that fall outside of the range specified by the observer location and the maximum distance

input_arguments.name: dst-nodata
input_arguments.description: The value to be set for the cells in the output raster that have no data.

input_arguments.name: observer-spacing
input_arguments.description: Cell Spacing between observers

input_arguments.name: num-threads
input_arguments.description: Number of jobs (or ALL_CPUS)
